sub_sections.title: Abhinna and Samapatti Core Alignment
sub_sections.fact: Vijja refers directly to the insight/knowledge derived from the 5 Abhinna (Higher Psychic Knowledges) and the 8 Samapatti (8 Meditative Jhanas)[span_52](start_span)[span_52](end_span).

sub_sections.title: Magga-nana / Magga-panna (Path Wisdom)
sub_sections.fact: Vijja represents the Magga-nana or Magga-panna (specifically Arahattamagga-nana)—the path knowledge that eliminates all defilements by thoroughly realizing the Four Noble Truths[span_53](start_span)[span_53](end_span).

sub_sections.title: Phala-nana / Phala-panna (Fruition Wisdom)
sub_sections.fact: Vijja denotes the Phala-nana or Phala-panna (Fruition Knowledge)[span_54](start_span)[span_54](end_span).

sub_sections.title: The 5 Spiritual Faculties (Indriya)
sub_sections.fact: The 5 Spiritual Faculties present within the stage of Arahatta-phala (Faith, Energy, Mindfulness, Concentration, and Wisdom) are also regarded as Vijja because they actively support wisdom[span_55](start_span)[span_55](end_span).

sub_sections.title: Kammassakata-nana
sub_sections.fact: Vijja refers to Kammassakata-nana—the distinct knowledge that one's own intentional actions (kamma) are one's only true property[span_56](start_span)[span_56](end_span).

sub_sections.title: Samma-ditthi & Samma-sankappa
sub_sections.fact: Vijja signifies Samma-ditthi (Right View) as well as the harmonious combination of both Samma-ditthi and Samma-sankappa[span_57](start_span)[span_57](end_span).

sub_sections.title: Secular Arts, Mantras & Lore
points: Practical arts, such as the science of curing snake venom[span_61](start_span)[span_61](end_span)

sub_sections.title: Textual Canonical Alignment
sub_sections.fact: Vijja can refer to the specific 4 Suttas named the Vijja Suttas[span_63](start_span)[span_63](end_span).

sections.heading: 5. Vijjamagga Dipani & The 5 Essential Attributes (Angas)
five_classes_of_vijja: Ariya-vijja (the noble wisdom leading to Path, Fruition, and Nibbana) — the supreme transcendent wisdom obtainable exclusively within the Buddha's Dispensation[span_68](start_span)[span_68](end_span)

five_essential_attributes_for_ariya_vijj.name: Unshakable Faith in the Buddha
five_essential_attributes_for_ariya_vijj.description: Total conviction and confidence in the Buddha's supreme, self-enlightened wisdom[span_69](start_span)[span_69](end_span).

five_essential_attributes_for_ariya_vijj.name: Physical Health and Robustness
five_essential_attributes_for_ariya_vijj.description: Possessing a healthy body with a balanced digestive heat (Pasaka-dhathu) capable of processing food; critical baseline support for Vipassana meditation[span_70](start_span)[span_70](end_span). Respecting those worthy of veneration yields longevity, beauty, happiness, and strength[span_71](start_span)[span_71](end_span).

five_essential_attributes_for_ariya_vijj.name: Uprightness and Sincerity of Heart
five_essential_attributes_for_ariya_vijj.description: Being completely honest, without deceit or hypocrisy; opening up one's true spiritual state to a teacher transparently[span_72](start_span)[span_72](end_span).

five_essential_attributes_for_ariya_vijj.name: Intense and Ardent Energy (Viriya)
five_essential_attributes_for_ariya_vijj.description: Exerting relentless, unflagging effort to eradicate unwholesome states (akusala) and fulfill wholesome states (kusala) until the poisons of defilements are exhausted[span_73](start_span)[span_73](end_span).

five_essential_attributes_for_ariya_vijj.name: Possession of Vipassana Insight
five_essential_attributes_for_ariya_vijj.description: The internal wisdom to penetratingly perceive the continuous arising and passing away of both one's own mental/physical aggregates and those of others; accessible to Tihetuka individuals[span_74](start_span)[span_74](end_span).

sections.heading: 6. Architectural Integration: The Seed Framework

seed_of_carana.effect: Gains opportunities to encounter the Buddha's Sasana, instructions, and noble mentors[span_76](start_span)[span_76](end_span)

seed_of_vijja.components: The perfection of wisdom and insight (Panna-parami)[span_77](start_span)[span_77](end_span)
seed_of_vijja.effect: Possesses the innate capability to penetratingly comprehend ultimate truth upon hearing the Dhamma[span_78](start_span)[span_78](end_span)

historical_system_failures: Mahadhana and his wife: Possessed the Seed of Vijja but lacked the Seed of Carana, failing to attain the Dhamma[span_79](start_span)[span_79](end_span).
Saccaka the Ascetic: Possessed the Seed of Carana but was weak in the Seed of Vijja, preventing Dhamma attainment in that lifetime[span_80](start_span)[span_80](end_span).

primary_vector_for_disciples.critical_insight: Even if an individual does not acquire other psychic-related branches of Vijja, a highly matured Vipassana-nana alone is entirely sufficient to deliver a Savaka to Nibbana[span_82](start_span)[span_82](end_span). It serves as the fundamental practice (Pubbayoga) required for gaining Analytical Insights (Patisambhida-nana)[span_83](start_span)[span_83](end_span).
